svg.title: neofetch: thaitan@github
svg.desc: A neofetch-style card. A 3D voxel <T/> sign assembles from blocks flying in from every side inside a hologram projector, then ripples like a wave while a scan plane climbs it and two sparks orbit it on a tilted ring; beside it a raised panel, with a light circling its edge, lists role: full-stack developer; location: soc trang, vietnam; shipping: typescript across the stack; stack: react, node.js, postgresql, aws; focus: clean architecture, testing; certs: meta, google, ibm, aws, deeplearning.ai; github: duongthaitan, each value decrypting from noise, above eight 3D colour cubes in the terminal ANSI palette.
